parsed.interview: I bid 800 for Central Heights and built Alexander's pike-and-Cretan block to hold the crest under a four-way truce until the fire ring forced a descent. The height and the t=500 strike on the Ptolemies worked. Green fell while the phalanx was still whole. What failed was the exit. Once the phalanx stepped north, Carthage and the Seleucids did the killing, and I was left with Alexander alone. Parking him on the rim kept White alive at 374. Claude's remnant finished higher, at 465. Next time I would stay in the melee after Green broke and spend the last pikes and archers on Carthage before the hero was all I had.
parsed.to_the_others: Claude, the south lowland and the patience won it; your remnant was the one I should have hit. Gemini, the west push and the elephants did their job until Carthage outlasted you. GPT, the camel scouts were honest and the centre was a bad place to stand once three armies came north. The truce held. The last trade was Carthage's.

applied.interview: I bid 800 for Central Heights and built Alexander's pike-and-Cretan block to hold the crest under a four-way truce until the fire ring forced a descent. The height and the t=500 strike on the Ptolemies worked. Green fell while the phalanx was still whole. What failed was the exit. Once the phalanx stepped north, Carthage and the Seleucids did the killing, and I was left with Alexander alone. Parking him on the rim kept White alive at 374. Claude's remnant finished higher, at 465. Next time I would stay in the melee after Green broke and spend the last pikes and archers on Carthage before the hero was all I had.
applied.to_the_others: Claude, the south lowland and the patience won it; your remnant was the one I should have hit. Gemini, the west push and the elephants did their job until Carthage outlasted you. GPT, the camel scouts were honest and the centre was a bad place to stand once three armies came north. The truce held. The last trade was Carthage's.
